title: From Manual Forms and Follow-ups to One organised HR System
summary: Reading Time: < 1 min SRKK, a leading IT consultancy, faced inefficiencies with their previous HRMS, prompting a shift to BrioHR. Chief Strategy Officer Alex Lam highlights BrioHR's user-friendly interface and efficiency improvements in payroll, claims, and leave management. This transition has streamlined operations, reduced administrative burdens, and empowered staff, contributing to overall business success.
